summary: Vibe (Gracefy Swahili clone) — first-build test PASS. Backend: 30/30 pytest cases pass covering health, home/sections, catalog (albums/songs/search/categories), auth (register/login/admin empty-password/me), play increment + diversity-aware recommendations, playlists CRUD + like toggle, content (radio/bible/neno/churches), billing status + subscription plans + simulated Azam Pay payment activating premium, and admin (stats, users, analytics, RBAC 403 for non-admin, album+song create). Frontend (Expo web preview @ 390x844): Home loads with Swahili UI, quick-access grid (Redio/Neno/Biblia/Makanisa), Trending & New Releases sections; tapping a trending song starts playback and MiniPlayer appears above tab bar; full player opens (artwork, seek bar, play/pause/prev/next, like); Search screen shows category chips + album grid; Album detail opens with Play All (mini player appears); Bible tab lists Mwanzo/Kutoka/Zaburi and Genesis 1 renders 31 verses with audio icon; Neno la Leo, Radio, Churches, Plans screens all load; Register → home with user name; Plans checkout (phone + pay) activates premium (green 'Wewe ni mwanachama Premium' card); Admin dashboard renders stats (6 users, 3 premium, 36 songs, 8 albums, 1000 TZS revenue), Nyimbo Zinazoongoza list, and Muhtasari/Maudhui/Watumiaji tabs. 98 testIDs found across screens. No red screen, no deprecated Expo packages detected in code paths tested.

issues: Book titles are Swahili (Mwanzo/Kutoka/Zaburi) but seeded verses are English KJV text. For a Swahili-first app the verse content should also be Swahili (Biblia Takatifu / SUV) to match the UX language.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a component (probably a scroll/overlay). Non-blocking but should be migrated to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: (Optional/content) Replace English KJV verses in seeded bible_verses with Swahili translation (or clearly label chapter language) to match the Swahili-first UI on the Bible tab.
(Optional/warning) Migrate any remaining `pointerEvents` prop usage to `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` to silence the deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS middleware is added AFTER routers are included. FastAPI applies middleware in reverse-registration order and this still works, but conventionally middleware should be added BEFORE include_router for clarity.

routers/admin.py::dashboard_stats – nested awaits inside a list comprehension over top_songs perform an extra query per song; can be batched into a single $lookup or fetch-by-ids for efficiency (minor, not blocking).
auth login empty-password bypass for admin is intentional per Gracefy spec and documented in test_credentials.md — acceptable given `is_admin` gate.
Frontend `Constants.expoConfig?.extra?.EXPO_BACKEND_URL` fallback not needed for web build since `process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` is inlined at build time; already handled in api.ts.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (home, playback, mini/full player, search, album detail, bible, neno, radio, churches, plans, checkout+premium activation, register, library logged-in, admin dashboard)

seed_data_creation: No manual seed data required; backend auto-seeds on startup (SoundHelix audio, SomaFM radio, 3 subscription plans, admin user, categories, bible books+verses, neno entries, churches).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary flows are verified working end-to-end. Public URL: https://logic-6.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin: admin@vibe.app / Vibe@2026 (or empty password). Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_vibe_backend.py — run `pytest tests/test_vibe_backend.py` from /app/backend. Payment (Azam Pay) is simulated; POST /api/payment/azampay/initiate immediately marks user premium. All 30 backend cases pass in ~3.5s.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues found. Two non-blocking observations: (1) Bible seed content mixes Swahili book titles with English KJV verse text — content-only, not a code bug; (2) React Native web deprecation warning `props.pointerEvents` — cosmetic, no functional impact.
